source_contract: Untouched MathArena parser runs in candidate-only pinned container. Bounded explicit symbolic data reconstructs and source comparison run inside ScriptSpec 50-second deadline; trusted references never enter candidate container. Existing isolated HumanEval function RPC reused. Source list multiplicity, strict numeric tolerance, ten repetition metrics retained.
representation: Opt-in model_answers use JSON primitive/display values instead of SymPy/AnswerList objects. Display conversion occurs within deadline. Framework reports are equal after that explicit serialization; object-type equivalence is not claimed.
scoring_fixes: Empty filtered trusted answer lists are invalid tasks; untouched source awards vacuous equality. Nontext/unsupported candidate values score zero. Raw outputs are recomputed; stale parsed answers cannot bypass grading.
limitations: Fixture-only, no model inference or archived validated-score replay. Dataset selection and model outputs supplied as fixtures; actual source generate_responses/evaluate_responses methods run.

Explicit bounded symbolic node contract: 32 levels, 4096 nodes, 65536 integer bits, root degree 16; unsupported expressions receive zero. Audited all 30 canonical gold and 18 ordinary alternative forms; this is not proof of every arbitrary SymPy expression.
Source baseline transports untouched parser and check_answers together in same pinned image without cutover codec; framework aggregation remains original.
MathArena source compatibility and existing function-RPC adapter are pinned; install/load image and both prerequisite harness patches before use.
